content.text: You are working on a software project as one member of a team. You can read and change files in the project's workspace only through the tools you are given. Paths are relative to the workspace. Do what the user asks, using the tools, then reply with a short summary of what you did.
Reply with the single word hello. Don't use any tool.

function.description: Read a text file in the workspace. Returns its lines, each with its line number. Use offset and limit to read part of a large file. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <work>/scratch, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.
function.name: Read

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace, such as src/a.py.

offset.description: The first line to read, from 1.

function.description: Create a file, or replace a whole file, with the content given. Missing directories are made. To change part of a file, use Edit. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <work>/scratch, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.
function.name: Write

content.description: The whole of the file's new content.

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace.

function.description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. old_string must occur exactly once, unless replace_all is true. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <work>/scratch, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.
function.name: Edit

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place.

function.description: List the files whose paths match a pattern: * matches within one part of a path, ? one character, and ** any number of parts, as in src/**/*.py. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <work>/scratch, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.
function.name: Glob

path.description: The directory to search, relative to the workspace.

function.description: Search files for lines matching a regular expression (Python's syntax). Returns each match as path:line:text. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <work>/scratch, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.
function.name: Grep

glob.description: Only search files whose paths match this pattern.

path.description: A file or directory to search, relative to the workspace.

function.description: Delete one file. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <work>/scratch, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.
function.name: Delete

file_path.description: The file, relative to the workspace.

function.description: Move or rename one file. The destination must not exist yet; missing directories are made. Temporary files go in the scratch directory, <work>/scratch, by absolute path: they need no effect, and are removed when the run ends.
function.name: Move

destination.description: Where it goes, relative to the workspace.

source.description: The file to move, relative to the workspace.
